title: DIPA: Distilled Preconditioned Algorithms for Solving Imaging Inverse Problems
summary: Solving imaging inverse problems has usually been addressed by designing proper prior models of the underlying signal. However, minimizing the data fidelity term poses significant challenges due to the ill-conditioned sensing matrix caused by physical constraints in the acquisition system. Thus, preconditioning techniques have been adopted in classical optimization theory to address ill-conditioned data-fidelity minimization by transforming the algorithm gradient step to achieve faster convergence and better numerical stability. We extend the preconditioning concept beyond convergence…
